name: Augusto Aprile
original_name: アウグスト・アプリーレ
source:
Head of the Aprile family.

[spoiler]He stole the Holy Grail Clock from Oscar. During the battle against the girls, he seized the second clock that they had brought from the future. This triggered a time paradox that sent him back to antiquity, where he spent his entire life searching for a way to return to the present.[/spoiler]
translation:
Head of the Aprile family.

[spoiler]He stole the Holy Grail Clock from Oscar. During the battle against the girls, he seized the second clock that they had brought from the future. This triggered a time paradox that sent him back to antiquity, where he spent his entire life searching for a way to return to the present.[/spoiler]
